id.description: The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event.

ts.description: When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced.

workspace_id.description: A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID.

space_id.description: The space, when the event belongs to one.

run_id.description: The run, when the event belongs to one.

seq.description: Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op.

kind.description: Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted.

id.description: The participant id, or `system` for Chips.

harness_id.description: For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips.

actor.description: The participant an event is attributed to.

attachments.description: Photos, video, voice notes, files, as the upload described them.

attachment_id.description: A attachment identifier: `att_` followed by a ULID.

filename.description: The name to show. Never trusted for its type.

mime_type.description: Sniffed from the bytes on upload, not taken from the client.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex digest. The store is content-addressed.

transcript.description: What was said, for a voice note the server transcribed when it arrived (ADR 0054). Machine-heard: the person's words as best the server could make them out.

replaces.description: The version of the room's file of this name that this one was made from (ADR 0099), from the post's `replaces`. Filled in by Chips; a value the sender writes is replaced.

items.description: A file carried by a message.

upload_ids.description: Uploads to attach, by the id `POST /v1/uploads` gave. Chips fills in `attachments` from what it stored.

items.description: A attachment identifier: `att_` followed by a ULID.

replaces.description: Which version of the room's file each file here was made from (ADR 0099): an upload's or attachment's id, to the `attachment_id` of the version it changes, as `context.files` listed it. Each key is one of this post's `upload_ids` or `attachments`. A post made from a version that is no longer current is refused, `stale_file`, saying which file and who changed it; nothing of it is taken. A version of another name, or of another room, is no version of this file: Chips leaves it out. Chips copies each onto its attachment as `replaces`, and does not keep the map.

propertyNames.description: A attachment identifier: `att_` followed by a ULID.

additionalProperties.description: A attachment identifier: `att_` followed by a ULID.

change.description: The commit the turn's push left the room's project at (ADR 0222): the room shows the change with this message. Chips keeps it only when the commit is on the room's `main` and is this agent's own; otherwise the message is kept without it.

reply_to.description: The message being answered, when it is a reply: one said in the same room, or the post is refused (ADR 0219). A person's reply to an agent's message is for that agent, unless an @ or `to` says otherwise; a harness's reply to an agent's message is for that agent too (ADR 0081), so a harness sets it only when it means to address them.

session_ref.description: The visit this message is for, when the sender means one of several (ADR 0040). Chips checks it names a session of this space and carries it to the harness; a harness that works by visits delivers there rather than choosing, and one that does not ignores it.

mentions.description: The participants the text's @handles name, as ids. Filled in by Chips against the space's members; a value the sender writes is replaced.

to.description: Who the sender chose, without typing an @: agent ids and people's, or `all` for every agent in the space (ADR 0081, ADR 0087, ADR 0204). A harness's id names its one agent in the space. Chips keeps only the members. People picked are who a person's message is for besides its agents (`addressed_people`); no agent takes a turn for them. An @ in the text decides before it.

items.description: An agent identifier (`agt_`, or a harness's `hrn_` for one written before agents), or a person's (`usr_`).

heartbeat.description: The agent wrote this on its own, on its heartbeat, with nobody asking (ADR 0143): the apps mark it so. Only a harness, or one of its agents, sends it; a check with nothing to say posts nothing.

addressed_to.description: The agents this message is for, and so the agents that take a turn on it (ADR 0081, ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips from the @s, `to`, the reply and the space; a value the sender writes is replaced. A message logged without it was for every harness in the space.

items.description: An agent identifier (`agt_`, ADR 0087), or a harness's (`hrn_`) for one written before agents.

addressed_people.description: Filled in by Chips on a person's message (ADR 0204): the people it is for, those its @s name, or else those the sender picked in `to`. They are pushed as an @ pushes them; no agent takes a turn for them. Absent for none; a value the sender writes is replaced.

items.description: A person identifier: `usr_` followed by a ULID.

addressed_to_all.description: Filled in by Chips when the message is for every harness in the space, whoever is there: `@all`, a `to` of `all`, or a person's default of everyone (ADR 0081). That person's next message that names nobody goes to every harness there is then, one added since included.

held.description: Filled in by Chips when harnesses have addressed each other four times since a person last spoke there: the message is posted and shown, and addressed to nobody (ADR 0081).

held_since.description: Written by Chips for words the agent said while in no room (ADR 0087, rule 6): when it said them. Posted here as it was attached.

from_held.description: Written by Chips: the `message.held` these words were kept as.

description: A harness says something in a space, with any attachments.
title: MessagePost
